name: Major League Hacking (MLH) hackathons
what_you_do: Major League Hacking runs student hackathons. These are short coding contests. It also runs coding events. It has a 12-week remote Fellowship that pays a stipend. Most listed hackathons do not say high school students can enter.
who_can_apply: Rules differ by event. On the 2027 events list only one event (hackPHS in New Jersey) is marked High School. The Fellowship page gives no age or student rule. Read each event page.
pay_detail: Event costs are not listed on the pages read; check each event. The Fellowship pays a stipend (amount not stated).
deadline_text: Dates differ by event. See the 2027 season events list. California events listed: DiamondHacks (La Jolla, Apr 4 to 5, 2027) and LA Hacks (Los Angeles, Apr 16 to 18, 2027).
how_to_apply: Browse the events list on mlh.com and read each event's age rule before registering.
notes: The pages read did not state a minimum age. Many MLH events are aimed at college students, so check before you plan travel.
